implementation.admission: The existing option grammar owns TEMP/TNOM. Missing scalar names defer only under typed UndefinedParam; ordinary option overlays still require immediately available values. Conditional and source boundaries remain owned by the full parser.
implementation.scope: Pending expressions resolve at root/subcircuit closure in authored order within that scope. Referenced existing complex values and compiled function bodies retain option-card meanings. Only missing values use completed-scope bindings; sibling scopes cannot supply them.
implementation.precedence: A deck-wide ordinal preserves last-authored option precedence across nested scopes and immediate/deferred assignments. Superseded active expressions still evaluate and validate. Physical study TEMP and single .TEMP precedence are unchanged.
implementation.statistics: The missing-reference probe uses an isolated random counter. Immediate expressions consume live draws only once. Deferred expressions draw after declarations when their scope closes, in authored order within that scope, including lazy and user-function evaluation. Bounded temperature replay restarts the same seeded input.
implementation.diagnostics: Deferred errors carry their original physical file and logical-card opening line rather than the resolution boundary. Root/subcircuit pending lists poll cancellation between expressions and do not scan unrelated scopes.
implementation.storage: Only referenced numeric values and compiled expression/function programs are retained. The common known-scalar path does not copy the full parameter context. A conservative isolated context copy remains for probing potentially missing bindings.
